points.description: States that the slightly different salt solution (salt concentration) is still within the range of salt concentration/conditions that brine shrimp eggs can tolerate and hatch in (equivalent wording: the eggs can hatch under a range of salinities; the small difference in spoon size did not change the concentration enough to prevent hatching). A bare statement such as 'the eggs were lucky' or 'some eggs are stronger' without reference to tolerance range/acceptable salt concentration does not earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark: the answer says the new solution's salt level is still within the eggs' tolerance range (acceptable range of conditions) for hatching. No marks: answers that don't refer to a range or tolerance, e.g. luck, or that the spoon size didn't matter at all with no mention of the range, or that the solution was the same.
